title: Interactive Personal Finance Dashboard
tagline: Modern financial analytics platform with real-time balance trends, expense breakdown, and role-based access.
description: A comprehensive personal finance and budget analytics web application built with React, Vite, and interactive data visualizations. Features live balance tracking, categorized expense analytics, dynamic financial health insights, and role-based access control (Viewer Mode vs Admin Mode) with full transaction management.
features: Dynamic KPI metric cards tracking Total Balance ($3,647+), Income, and Expenses
Interactive balance growth trend line chart and category-wise spending breakdown pie chart
Financial health insights highlighting highest spending categories and saving rate (89.5%)
Real-time transaction search, filtering (All / Income / Expenses), and date sorting
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with Viewer Mode and Admin Mode (+Add / Edit / Delete)

title: Vigovia - Travel Itinerary Generator
tagline: Interactive trip planning platform with daily activity scheduling, flight/hotel logistics, and PDF export.
description: A comprehensive travel itinerary and vacation management platform engineered to streamline multi-day trip planning. Enables travelers to organize morning, afternoon, and evening schedules, track flight and hotel bookings, monitor visa status pipelines, manage installment payment plans, and generate exportable PDF itineraries.
features: Dynamic trip builder with day-by-day morning, afternoon, and evening activity scheduling
Integrated flight logistics with amenity toggles (meals, baggage, seat preference, entertainment)
Hotel booking management with city-wise check-in/out tracking and stay duration calculations
Visa status tracking pipeline (Not Required, Applied, Approved, In Process)
Customizable payment plan & installment schedule with automated total balance and TCS tracking
One-click downloadable PDF itinerary export for offline travel reference

title: Ravi Teja Home Foods
tagline: D2C traditional sweets & foods platform with dynamic catalog, smart cart drawer, and order tracking.
description: A production direct-to-consumer (D2C) food e-commerce platform engineered for an authentic South Indian homemade sweets brand. Built a high-conversion digital shopping storefront featuring organized product collections (Annamayya Laddu, Aresalu, Dry fruit specialties), interactive flyout cart with instant price calculations, customer order lookup workflows, and mobile-first responsiveness.
features: Dynamic catalog browsing across traditional Andhra sweets, savories, and seasonal festival packs
Interactive Quick-Add and slide-over Cart Drawer with real-time quantity modifiers and price updates
Customer order lookup and tracking pipeline for real-time shipment transparency
Mobile-optimized touch interface tested for seamless performance across smartphones and tablets
Seamless checkout experience integrated with localized currency formatting and tax calculations

title: Smart Video Feed & Stream Interact
tagline: Real-time educational video streaming platform with NLP keyword mapping & contextual AI chatbot.
description: An interactive educational video streaming platform enabling users to upload, watch, and engage with learning content in real time. Features NLP keyword matching to extract relevant topics from video content and map them to contextual responses, integrated with an AI-powered chatbot that answers user questions during active playback.
features: Real-time video streaming architecture enabling interactive student engagement
NLP keyword matching engine extracting relevant topics from video transcripts
Embedded AI-powered chatbot providing contextual answers during video playback
Responsive ReactJS frontend with Node.js and MongoDB backend architecture

title: ezstaf - AI Mobile Job Platform
tagline: Production mobile recruitment platform released to Google Play Store with Flutter, FastAPI, & MCP Server.
description: A production cross-platform mobile application published on the Google Play Store connecting job seekers with recruiters. Spearheaded the end-to-end engineering and release lifecycle: built high-performance Flutter mobile interfaces, engineered scalable FastAPI microservices with PostgreSQL, integrated conversational AI workflows via Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, and constructed an audio pipeline using Speech-to-Text and ffmpeg.
features: End-to-end engineering leadership through Google Play Store production release
Cross-platform mobile application engineered with Flutter for smooth candidate onboarding
High-performance backend RESTful microservices powered by FastAPI and PostgreSQL
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration for intelligent conversational job discovery
Speech-to-Text (STT) processing pipeline and ffmpeg audio handling for voice-assisted search
Production-grade JWT authentication, candidate profile management, and secure resume handling

title: Applicant Management System
tagline: End-to-end automated recruitment & hiring platform with RBAC security and real-time tracking.
description: A full-featured Applicant Management System developed to automate end-to-end recruitment and hiring workflows. Designed with secure role-based access control (RBAC), job posting management, candidate application lifecycles, interview coordination, and real-time application status monitoring.
features: Automated recruitment pipelines for job postings, candidate submissions, and hiring decisions
Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across recruiters, interviewers, and admins
Real-time applicant tracking, resume management, and interview schedule coordination
High-speed backend microservices built with FastAPI and MySQL relational database

title: Server & Project Portfolio Management System
tagline: Centralized organizational resource management for server clusters, projects, and domain records.
description: A centralized web application engineered to manage enterprise infrastructure and organizational resources through dedicated Servers, Projects, and Domains modules. Features complete CRUD operations, strict data validation, and administrative controls for efficient resource tracking and operational visibility.
features: Dedicated organizational modules for Servers, Projects, and Domain assets
Complete CRUD capabilities for adding, updating, searching, and decommissioning records
Administrative functionalities with secure data handling and operational efficiency
Scalable MongoDB document storage paired with responsive ReactJS UI
